static_traits.name: Lin Peiqin
static_traits.occupation: Works as an employee at a small family-run restaurant
static_traits.social_status: Having a few friends to confide in,但对这一具体问题not愿与他们讨论
static_traits.medical_history: without类似心理问题史,without既往心理治疗经历,No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperation, positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: 因为一位姐姐很久have not联系,我一直感到非常Anxiety和难过,确信她恨我并且再也not想与我说话.
basic_info.core_demands: Sought counseling for the first time due to emotional intensity and its impact on daily life.
growth_experiences: 在一次打猎旅行中带错了弹药,这个被自己视为'基础错误'的失误对自我身份('我是个猎手')造成显著冲击.此后她频繁出现强烈Self-doubt,担心not yet来会再次犯错,降低了对打猎的享受并开始疏远一起打猎的朋友;当想到狩猎或与猎友互动时,常感到Anxiety与羞耻.她也尝试过自我安慰或正念,但Self-doubt并not yet明显缓解.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / incompetent

special_situations.event: 姐姐一段时间have not给我打电话或主动联系
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果亲人not主动联系,就意味着他们not再爱我,讨厌我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Making multiple calls and texts to confirm the relationship and try to restore contact
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她恨我,并且永远not想再和我说话

special_situations.event: 看到手机里have not姐姐的消息,或电话与短信not yet获回复
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果消息have not被回复,就等于被彻底拒绝
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复查看手机,持续尝试联系以缓解not安

special_situations.event: Recalling the mistake of bringing the wrong ammunition last hunt
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我犯过一次基础错误,就说明我not是真正的合格猎手
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing participation in hunting activities and distancing from hunting companions to avoid making mistakes and being judged again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not是合格的猎手,而且以后会一直犯错

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be continuously cared for, loved, and accepted by family (especially the older sister); to be recognized as a 'qualified person' in an important domain (hunting)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected或被抛弃;害怕再次犯错并遭到他人的评判与羞辱
defense_goal: 通过频繁主动联系来缓解被抛弃的Anxiety,维持关系的安全感
Avoids the hunting circle and interacting with hunting friends to avoid erring again and being judged

object_relations.object_representation: A cold sister who refuses contact

object_relations.self_representation: 羞耻的失败者/not称职的猎手

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师Guidance她用证据与概率来检视'姐姐恨我/我not称职'的信念时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向将情绪与事实分离,认为通过纯理性分析即可掌控或消除not安(移情:以理性压过感受)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use温和,支持性的语气,邀请她同时觉察当下的情绪与身体感受,肯定其理性分析的能力,同时缓慢追问'这让你有什么感受',避免仅停留在逻辑层面.

manifestations: 当姐姐停止联系后,持续体验到'被not需要/not被爱'的感受
因羞耻与Self-doubt而疏远一起打猎的朋友,Social withdrawal
not愿向朋友谈及该问题,难以寻求支持

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: use'我应该/必须把这种基础错误绝not犯'之类的语句,将外界标准当作绝对准则

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 把原本想向他人表达的羞耻与担忧转向自己,选择忍耐not向朋友寻求帮助
Reduces contact with hunting companions; avoids participating in hunting

positive_force: Previously had many years of hunting experience and multiple successful experiences
Able to conduct rational self-examination and accept reality-testing exercises
首次Actively seeks counseling, positive attitude
Has some social support (several friends to confide in)
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing and mind reading lead to negative interpretations of relationships
自我苛责与'应该'语句ReinforcementIntrojection的价值条件
对Being rejected的高度敏感,过度依赖他人的联系来验证自我价值
回避与猎友互动,Social withdrawal,进一步加重孤立与Anxiety
Anxiety影响睡眠与食欲,降低Work表现

target_behavior.behavior: 在姐姐not yet联系时出现强烈Anxiety并反复打电话/发短信,反复查看手机
antecedent: 姐姐一段时间not yet联系
电话或短信not yet获得回复
看到手机里have not姐姐的消息
target_behavior.core_reason: 将对方not yet联系过度Interpretation为'被恨/被永久拒绝'(灾难化,读心术)以满足对被爱与安全的高需求
target_behavior.function: Seeks external validation and re-establishing connection to temporarily relieve the fear of being abandoned
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety升级,Decline in work performance,与朋友和家人Relationship tension,Sleep and appetite affected

target_behavior.behavior: 在狩猎领域的回避与Social withdrawal(减少参与狩猎,疏远猎友)
antecedent: Thinking about the mistake of bringing the wrong ammunition last time
Planning to participate in or talk about hunting activities
Worrying about being judged by hunting companions
target_behavior.core_reason: 一次失误被过度概括为整体without能或'not是真正的猎手',担心再次犯错被羞辱
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的评判与羞耻感,维持Self-protection
target_behavior.consequence: 对打猎的享受下降,社会互动减少,Persistent self-doubt与Anxiety
